queries.replacement_query:
#title:Wikidata properties in numerical order
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT  ?property ?propertyType ?propertyLabel ?propertyDescription
WHERE
  { ?property  wikibase:propertyType  ?propertyType
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  rdfs:label  ?property__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  rdfs:label  ?property__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?property__label_value), ?property__label_value, if(( isURI(?property) && strstarts(str(?property), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?property), "entity/"), str(?property))) AS ?propertyLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  schema:description  ?property__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?property__description_value AS ?propertyDescription)
  }
ORDER BY ASC(xsd:integer(strafter(str(?property), "P")))

queries.replacement_query:
#title:Number of labels for an item, split by language
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?q ?langcode ?langLabel (COUNT(?label) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { VALUES ?q { wd:Q43459 }
    ?q rdfs:label|skos:altLabel ?label
    BIND(lang(?label) AS ?langcode)
    ?lang  wdt:P218  ?langcode
    OPTIONAL
      { ?lang  rdfs:label  ?lang__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?lang  rdfs:label  ?lang__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?lang__label_value), ?lang__label_value, if(( isURI(?lang) && strstarts(str(?lang), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?lang), "entity/"), str(?lang))) AS ?langLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?q ?langcode ?langLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

queries.replacement_query:
PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  psv:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT  ?workLabel ?pubdate ?pubdatePrecision ?image ?typelabel ?english (URI(concat("https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=", substr(str(?work), 32))) AS ?reasonator) (if(bound(?english), ?english, ?reasonator) AS ?link)
WHERE
  { ?work  wdt:P50  wd:Q9068 ;
           wdt:P31  ?type .
    ?work p:P577/psv:P577 ?pubdateStatementNode
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q3331189 }
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q105420 }
    ?pubdateStatementNode
              wikibase:timeValue    ?pubdate ;
              wikibase:timePrecision  ?pubdatePrecision
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  wdt:P18  ?image }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?english  schema:about     ?work ;
                  schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "de" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?work__label_value), ?work__label_value, if(( isURI(?work) && strstarts(str(?work), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?work), "entity/"), str(?work))) AS ?workLabel)
    ?type  rdfs:label  ?typelabel
    FILTER ( lang(?typelabel) = "en" )
  }

# Original query:

   ?person wdt:P101 ?field; #?field = Q39680 for macroeconomics # Q39072 for microeconomics
     wdt:P27 ?place .
   ?field wdt:P279+ wd:Q8134 .
   ?person rdfs:label ?name filter (lang(?name) = "en")
   ?place rdfs:label ?nationality filter (lang(?nationality) = "en")
   ?field rdfs:label ?fieldname filter (lang(?fieldname) = "en")
MINUS{ ?person wdt:P31/wdt:P279? wd:Q15632617 } # exclude fictional people
} ORDER BY ASC(?fieldname)

PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?college ?collegeLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?alum) AS ?count)
WHERE
  {   { ?college  wdt:P31  wd:Q2581649 }
    UNION
      { ?college  wdt:P31  wd:Q3338504 }
    ?alum  wdt:P69  ?college
    MINUS
      { ?alum  wdt:P31  wd:Q15632617 }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?college  rdfs:label  ?college__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?college__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?college  rdfs:label  ?college__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?college__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?college__label_value), ?college__label_value, if(( isURI(?college) && strstarts(str(?college), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?college), "entity/"), str(?college))) AS ?collegeLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?college ?collegeLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?alum ?alumLabel ?supervisee ?superviseeLabel ?fieldLabel
WHERE
  { ?alum     wdt:P108  wd:Q459506 .
    ?supervisee  wdt:P184  ?alum
    OPTIONAL
      { ?supervisee  wdt:P101  ?field }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?alum  rdfs:label  ?alum__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?alum__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?alum  rdfs:label  ?alum__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?alum__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?alum__label_value), ?alum__label_value, if(( isURI(?alum) && strstarts(str(?alum), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?alum), "entity/"), str(?alum))) AS ?alumLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?supervisee  rdfs:label  ?supervisee__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?supervisee__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?supervisee  rdfs:label  ?supervisee__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?supervisee__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?supervisee__label_value), ?supervisee__label_value, if(( isURI(?supervisee) && strstarts(str(?supervisee), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?supervisee), "entity/"), str(?supervisee))) AS ?superviseeLabel)
    BIND(if(bound(?field), ?field, "unbound") AS ?field__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?field__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?field__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?field__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?field__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?field__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?field__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?field__label_value), ?field__label_value, if(( isURI(?field) && strstarts(str(?field), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?field), "entity/"), str(?field))) AS ?fieldLabel)
  }

queries.original_query:
SELECT ?discoverer ?discovererLabel  
	(COUNT(DISTINCT ?star) as ?count)
	(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(?starLabel); separator=", ") as ?stars)
WHERE
{
	?ppart wdt:P279* wd:Q523 .
	?star wdt:P31 ?ppart .
	?star wdt:P61 ?discoverer .
	SERVICE wikibase:label {
		bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],mul,en" .
		?discoverer rdfs:label ?discovererLabel .
		?star rdfs:label ?starLabel            
	}
}
GROUP BY ?discoverer ?discovererLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

SELECT  ?discoverer ?discovererLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?star) AS ?count) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?starLabel ; separator=', ') AS ?stars)
WHERE
  { ?ppart (wdt:P279)* wd:Q523 .

queries.replacement_query:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?player ?playerLabel ?article ?birthyear ?placeLabel
WHERE
  { ?player  wdt:P1303  wd:Q180733
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  wdt:P569  ?born }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  wdt:P19  ?place }
    BIND(year(?born) AS ?birthyear)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?article  schema:about     ?player ;
                  schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  rdfs:label  ?player__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?player__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  rdfs:label  ?player__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?player__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?player__label_value), ?player__label_value, if(( isURI(?player) && strstarts(str(?player), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?player), "entity/"), str(?player))) AS ?playerLabel)
    BIND(if(bound(?place), ?place, "unbound") AS ?place__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?place__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?place__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?place__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?place__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?place__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?place__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?place__label_value), ?place__label_value, if(( isURI(?place) && strstarts(str(?place), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?place), "entity/"), str(?place))) AS ?placeLabel)
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?birthyear)

PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?work ?workLabel ?author ?authorLabel ?article
WHERE
  { ?work  wdt:P50  ?author .
    ?work wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q5185279 .
    ?article  schema:about     ?work ;
              schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
    MINUS

SELECT  ?item ?title ?itemDescription

SELECT ?name (CONCAT("Born ",str(?born), ", ",?birthplace,"; Died ", str(?died)) as ?dates) ?article WHERE {
   ?person wdt:P19 ?place . # place of birth
   {?place wdt:P131* wd:Q23165 } UNION { ?place wdt:P131* ?county. ?county wdt:P47 wd:Q23165 }. # born in Oxfordshire or adjacent county 
   ?person wdt:P607 wd:Q361 . # involved in World War I
    # ?place wdt:P625 ?coord . # lat and long of birthplace
     MINUS { ?person wdt:P18 ?image }. #image
      ?person wdt:P569 ?dob . #date of birth
	BIND(YEAR(?dob) as ?born).
    OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:P570 ?dod }. #date of death
  BIND(YEAR(?dod) as ?died).
   ?person rdfs:label ?name filter (lang(?name) = "en")
   ?place rdfs:label ?birthplace filter (lang(?birthplace) = "en")
OPTIONAL{ ?article schema:about ?person. ?article schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/>.  }
} ORDER by ?birthplace

PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?type ?typeLabel (COUNT(?tw) AS ?twitter) (COUNT(?fb) AS ?facebook)
WHERE
  {   { ?t  wdt:P2002  ?tw }
    UNION
      { ?t  wdt:P2013  ?fb }
    ?t  wdt:P31  ?type
    FILTER ( ?type != wd:Q5 )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "[AUTO_LANGUAGE]" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?type__label_value), ?type__label_value, if(( isURI(?type) && strstarts(str(?type), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?type), "entity/"), str(?type))) AS ?typeLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?type ?typeLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?twitter)

SELECT  ?from ?fromLabel ?to ?toLabel ?rgb
WHERE
  {   { SELECT  (?fictional_war AS ?from) (?universe AS ?to) ("F7FF00" AS ?rgb)
        WHERE
          { ?fictional_war
                      wdt:P31  wd:Q17198419
            OPTIONAL
              { ?fictional_war
                          wdt:P1080  ?narr_universe
              }
            OPTIONAL
              { ?fictional_war

              }
            OPTIONAL

    UNION

PREFIX  pq:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX  ps:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?item ?itemLabel ?workLabel ?rel ?awardLabel (year(?time) AS ?year)
WHERE
  { VALUES ?award { wd:Q160082 wd:Q2052291 }
      { ?item  p:P166   ?s .
        ?s     ps:P166  ?award
        BIND("won" AS ?rel)
        ?item  wdt:P31  wd:Q5
      }
    UNION
      { ?item  p:P1411   ?s .
        ?s     ps:P1411  ?award
        BIND("nominated" AS ?rel)
        ?item  wdt:P31  wd:Q5
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?s  pq:P585  ?time }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?s  pq:P1686  ?work }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?award  rdfs:label  ?award__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?award__label_value) = "en" )

    OPTIONAL

        FILTER ( lang(?award__label_value) = "mul" )

PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  pq:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX  ps:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?collection ?collectionLabel ?partofLabel ?countryLabel ?size ?partLabel
WHERE
  { ?collection  p:P1436  ?s .
    ?s        ps:P1436  ?size
    OPTIONAL
      { ?s  pq:P518  ?part }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?collection  wdt:P361  ?partof
        MINUS
          { ?partof  wdt:P31  wd:Q13406463 }
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?collection  wdt:P17  ?country }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?collection  rdfs:label  ?collection__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?collection__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?collection  rdfs:label  ?collection__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?collection__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?collection__label_value), ?collection__label_value, if(( isURI(?collection) && strstarts(str(?collection), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?collection), "entity/"), str(?collection))) AS ?collectionLabel)
    BIND(if(bound(?partof), ?partof, "unbound") AS ?partof__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?partof__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?partof__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?partof__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?partof__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?partof__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?partof__label_value) = "mul" )

    BIND(if(bound(?partof__label_value), ?partof__label_value, if(( isURI(?partof) && strstarts(str(?partof), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?partof), "entity/"), str(?partof))) AS ?partofLabel)

    BIND(if(bound(?part), ?part, "unbound") AS ?part__label_subject)

queries.title: Oldest institution in each country that now acts as a museum

section_path: Oldest institution in each country that now acts as a museum

queries.replacement_query:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?countryLabel ?museum ?museumLabel (year(?earliest) AS ?year)
WHERE
  { { SELECT  ?country (MIN(?inception) AS ?earliest)
      WHERE
        { ?museum wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q33506 .
          ?museum (wdt:P131)?/wdt:P17 ?country .
          ?museum  wdt:P571  ?inception
        }
      GROUP BY ?country
    }
    ?museum wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q33506 .
    ?museum (wdt:P131)?/wdt:P17 ?country .
    ?museum  wdt:P571  ?earliest
    MINUS
      { ?country  wdt:P576  _:b0 }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?country  rdfs:label  ?country__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?country__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?country  rdfs:label  ?country__label_value

#title:Art works in Scottish museums by female artists, lacking an enwp article
SELECT DISTINCT ?work ?workLabel ?collectionLabel ?artistLabel ?statements WHERE {
  ?collection wdt:P31/wdt:P279? wd:Q207694.    # Art museum
  ?collection wdt:P131/wdt:P131? wd:Q22.       # Located in Scotland
  ?work wdt:P195 ?collection.       # Object in the collection
  ?work wdt:P170 ?artist.      # Creator of the object
  ?artist wdt:P21 wd:Q6581072.      # Female
  ?work wikibase:statements ?statements  # Number of statements in Wikidata
  MINUS{?enwp schema:about ?work; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/>} # Lacking an EnglishWP article
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,mul". }
} ORDER BY DESC(?statements)

SELECT DISTINCT  ?artist ?artistLabel ?genderLabel ?countryLabel (year(?death) AS ?deathyear)
WHERE
  { ?artist  wdt:P31  wd:Q5 .
    ?artist wdt:P106/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q1028181 .
    ?artist  wdt:P570  ?death
    FILTER ( year(?death) < 1800 )
    OPTIONAL

queries.original_query:
#title:Paintings by Russian artists from around the time of the Russian Revolution
SELECT ?work ?workLabel ?artistLabel ?date ?datePrecision ?image WHERE {
  ?work wdt:P31 wd:Q3305213 # paintings
        ; wdt:P170 ?artist .
  ?artist wdt:P27 wd:Q34266. # artist's nationality: Russian Empire
  ?work p:P571/psv:P571 ?node .
  ?node wikibase:timeValue ?date ; # date of painting
   wikibase:timePrecision ?datePrecision # precision of date (e.g. day, month, year)
        BIND(YEAR(?date) as ?year) FILTER(?year > 1905) FILTER(?year < 1930) #specify date range
        FILTER (?datePrecision > 8) # known year
 .?work wdt:P18 ?image # only show art that Commons has an image for
    SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,ru,et,de,fr". }
}

PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

WITH %artists AS {
?work wdt:P195 wd:Q636400; wdt:P170 ?artist FILTER (!ISBLANK(?artist))
}
SELECT  ?languageLabel (COUNT(?sitelink) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { { SELECT ?artist WHERE { INCLUDE %artists } }
?sitelink  schema:about      ?artist ;
              schema:inLanguage  ?lang
    FILTER contains(str(?sitelink), ".wikipedia.org")
    ?language  wdt:P218  ?lang
    OPTIONAL
      { ?language  rdfs:label  ?language__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?language__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?language  rdfs:label  ?language__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?language__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?language__label_value), ?language__label_value, if(( isURI(?language) && strstarts(str(?language), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?language), "entity/"), str(?language))) AS ?languageLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?languageLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

SELECT  ?person ?personLabel ?personDescription (SAMPLE(?image) AS ?img) (COUNT(?item) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { ?item  wdt:P195  wd:Q636400 ;
           wdt:P973  ?url
    FILTER strstarts(str(?url), "http://jameelcentre")

      { ?person  wdt:P18  ?image }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?person  rdfs:label  ?person__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?person__label_value) = "en" )

      { ?person  rdfs:label  ?person__label_value

    OPTIONAL
      { ?person  schema:description  ?person__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?person__description_value) = "en" )

PREFIX  pq:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX  ps:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?item ?itemLabel ?inventory (GROUP_CONCAT(?typeLabel ; separator=', ') AS ?types) (year(?earliest) AS ?from) (year(?latest) AS ?to)
WHERE
  { ?item  p:P195    _:b0 .
    _:b0   ps:P195   wd:Q636400 ;
           pq:P217   ?inventory .
    ?item  wdt:P186  wd:Q37681 ;
           wdt:P31   ?type ;
           wdt:P973  ?url
    FILTER strstarts(str(?url), "http://jameelcentre")
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  p:P571    _:b1 .
        _:b1   pq:P1319  ?earliest ;
               pq:P1326  ?latest
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?item__label_value), ?item__label_value, if(( isURI(?item) && strstarts(str(?item), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?item), "entity/"), str(?item))) AS ?itemLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?type__label_value), ?type__label_value, if(( isURI(?type) && strstarts(str(?type), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?type), "entity/"), str(?type))) AS ?typeLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?inventory ?earliest ?latest
ORDER BY ?from ?to ?itemLabel

    FILTER ( ?era NOT IN (wd:Q11358452, wd:Q11509224, wd:Q1145058) )
    MINUS

?work wdt:P50 wd:Q538767. # work by Macaulay
?edition wdt:P629 ?work; # edition of work
 wdt:P1476 ?title; # title of edition
 wdt:P3939 ?estc; # ESTC Citation number
 wdt:P577 ?pubdate.

OPTIONAL { ?edition wdt:P1104 ?pages } # no of pages
} ORDER BY ?year ?no

queries.original_query:
#defaultView:Map
SELECT ?label ?loc ?subj
WHERE
{
   ?subj wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q839954 ; # site or subtype
      wdt:P625 ?loc ; # location to plot on map
          p:P625/psv:P625 ?coord; # coordinate-location statement
      rdfs:label ?label filter (lang(?label) = "en").
  ?coord wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat .
  ?coord wikibase:geoLongitude ?long .
   FILTER (?lat > 49) FILTER (?lat < 63)
   FILTER (?long > -10.5) FILTER (?long < 2.02) 
}

PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?i ?iLabel ?collLabel ?inv ?image
WHERE
  { ?i  wdt:P195  ?coll .
    ?coll (wdt:P361)? wd:Q63160499
    OPTIONAL
      { ?i  wdt:P217  ?inv }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?i  wdt:P18  ?image }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?i  rdfs:label  ?i__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?i__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?i  rdfs:label  ?i__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?i__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?i__label_value), ?i__label_value, if(( isURI(?i) && strstarts(str(?i), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?i), "entity/"), str(?i))) AS ?iLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?coll  rdfs:label  ?coll__label_value

queries.title: 100 most interesting Khalili Collections objects from Hajj and Islamic Art collections

source.section: 100 most interesting Khalili Collections objects from Hajj and Islamic Art collections
section_path: 100 most interesting Khalili Collections objects from Hajj and Islamic Art collections

queries.original_query:
#title:100 most interesting Khalili Collections Islamic objects
SELECT ?item ?itemLabel (SAMPLE(?typeLabel) AS ?what) ?itemDescription ?image ?s WHERE {
  VALUES ?coll {wd:Q66455355 wd:Q66458773} # Islamic Art and Hajj collection
  ?item wdt:P195 ?coll
  FILTER (?item NOT IN (wd:Q3114572, wd:Q109341408, wd:Q2997010, wd:Q108543136, wd:Q107663626) ).# Exclude objects in multiple collections
  ?item wdt:P18 ?image.
  ?item wdt:P31 ?type.
  ?item wikibase:statements ?s
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "ar,[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en".
  ?type rdfs:label ?typeLabel. ?item rdfs:label ?itemLabel. ?item schema:description ?itemDescription }
} GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?itemDescription ?image ?s
ORDER BY DESC(?s)
LIMIT 100

    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "ar" )
      }

        FILTER ( lang(?item__description_value) = "ar" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  schema:description  ?item__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__description_value) = "en" )

queries.original_query:
#title: Things connected to art works of the Khalili Collections
SELECT DISTINCT (?nameplusdesc AS ?label) (GROUP_CONCAT(STR(?link)) AS ?links) WHERE {
  VALUES ?prop {wdt:P180 wdt:P50 wdt:P88 wdt:P1774 wdt:P31}
  # depicted creator commissioned_by workshop_of instance_of
  ?work wdt:P195 ?coll. ?coll wdt:P361 wd:Q63160499. ?work wdt:P973 ?link; ?prop ?depicted.
  FILTER (CONTAINS(STR(?link), "khalilicollections"))  
 FILTER (?depicted NOT IN (wd:Q79496108, wd:Q153988, wd:Q22669850, wd:Q87167, wd:Q48498,
                          wd:Q49848, wd:Q639460, wd:Q987767, wd:Q1922981, wd:Q2142903,
                          wd:Q18593264, wd:Q29382731, wd:Q368972, wd:Q3305213,
                          wd:Q17379525, wd:Q22075301, wd:Q191851))
# enamel bowl calligraphic_work manuscript illuminated_manuscript document casket container glassware
# jewellery item_of_collection metal_artwork lacquerware painting pottery_ware textile_artwork vase
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en".
                            ?depicted rdfs:label ?name. ?depicted schema:description ?desc}
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?desc), CONCAT(?name, ", ", ?desc), ?name) AS ?nameplusdesc)
} GROUP BY ?nameplusdesc 
ORDER BY UCASE(?label)

  ?item wdt:P195/wdt:P361 wd:Q63160499. # Object from one of the Khalili Collections
     ?item rdfs:label ?label_for FILTER(lang(?label_for) != "en"). # Translated label

}

#title:Other heritage registers that include MoW International Register inscriptions

PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?register ?registerLabel ?registerDescription (COUNT(?item) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { ?item  wdt:P1435  wd:Q16024238 ;
           wdt:P1435  ?register
    FILTER ( ?register != wd:Q16024238 )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?register  rdfs:label  ?register__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?register__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?register  rdfs:label  ?register__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?register__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?register__label_value), ?register__label_value, if(( isURI(?register) && strstarts(str(?register), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?register), "entity/"), str(?register))) AS ?registerLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?register  schema:description  ?register__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?register__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?register__description_value AS ?registerDescription)
  }
GROUP BY ?register ?registerLabel ?registerDescription
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

#defaultView:ImageGrid{"hide": ["?image"]}
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?instLabel ?inst (COUNT(?item) AS ?count) (SAMPLE(?image_or_blank) AS ?image)
WHERE
  { ?item  wdt:P1435  wd:Q16024238 ;
           wdt:P276   ?inst
    OPTIONAL
      { ?inst  wdt:P18  ?img }
    BIND(if(bound(?img), ?img, <http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/No%20image%20available.svg>) AS ?image_or_blank)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?inst  rdfs:label  ?inst__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?inst__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?inst  rdfs:label  ?inst__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?inst__label_value) = "mul" )
      }

  }
GROUP BY ?instLabel ?inst

queries.original_query:
#title:Count of Wikipedia articles about specific Memory of the World inscriptions
SELECT ?langname (COUNT(?item) AS ?count)  WHERE {
  ?item p:P1435 ?s. ?s ps:P1435 wd:Q16024238. # Heritage designation: MotW
 MINUS {?item wdt:P485/wdt:P1435 wd:Q16024238} # exclude "archives at:"
 ?site schema:about ?item ; schema:inLanguage ?langcode. FILTER(CONTAINS(str(?site), ".wikipedia.org/") )
OPTIONAL { ?language wdt:P305 ?langcode; rdfs:label ?langlabel FILTER(lang(?langlabel) = "en") } # Convert short code to full language name
BIND(COALESCE(?langlabel, ?langcode) AS ?langname)
} GROUP BY ?langname
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX  ps:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?motwLabel ?item ?itemLabel ?itemDescription
WHERE
  { ?motw  p:P1435   ?s .
    ?s     ps:P1435  wd:Q16024238 .
    ?item wdt:P195|wdt:P361 ?motw
    OPTIONAL
      { ?motw  rdfs:label  ?motw__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?motw__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?motw  rdfs:label  ?motw__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?motw__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?motw__label_value), ?motw__label_value, if(( isURI(?motw) && strstarts(str(?motw), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?motw), "entity/"), str(?motw))) AS ?motwLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?item__label_value), ?item__label_value, if(( isURI(?item) && strstarts(str(?item), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?item), "entity/"), str(?item))) AS ?itemLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  schema:description  ?item__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?item__description_value AS ?itemDescription)
  }
ORDER BY ?motwLabel

SELECT DISTINCT ?langname ?itemLabel ?site  WHERE {

 ?item (wdt:P195{{!}}wdt:P361{{!}}wdt:P485) ?motw .

}

PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>

PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

#title:Wikipedia articles about Memory of the World Register inscriptions
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?langname ?itemLabel ?link
WHERE
  { ?item  wdt:P1435          wd:Q473858 .
    ?link  schema:about       ?item ;
           schema:inLanguage  ?langcode
    FILTER contains(str(?link), ".wikipedia.org/")
    OPTIONAL
      { ?language  wdt:P218   ?langcode ;
                  rdfs:label  ?langlabel
        FILTER ( lang(?langlabel) = "en" )

    OPTIONAL

    OPTIONAL
